title: MedGemma Technical Report
authors: Andrew Sellergren, Sahar Kazemzadeh, Tiam Jaroensri, Atilla Kiraly, et al.
imaging_modality: Chest X-Ray (CXR), CT, MRI, Pathology, Dermatology
dataset: MIMIC-CXR, CheXpert, CXR14, US-Derm, Path MCQA
task: Report Generation, Classification, Visual Question Answering
main_results: Established state-of-the-art open medical multimodal baseline; high performance in zero-shot and fine-tuned settings.
limitations: High memory footprint in uncompressed 27B variant; requires quantization for edge.
notes: Primary foundation model evaluated in the dissertation.

title: MedGemma 1.5 Technical Report
authors: Andrew Sellergren, Fereshteh Mahvar, Chufan Gao, Timo Kohlberger, et al.
imaging_modality: Chest X-Ray, 3D CT, MRI, Lab Reports (PDF/PNG)
dataset: EHRQA, MS-CXR-T, CT-RATE, Chest ImaGenome, MIMIC-CXR
task: Longitudinal Report Generation, Anatomy Grounding, Structured Extraction
evaluation_metrics: Macro F1 (77.8% Lab Extraction), RadGraph F1, Accuracy
main_results: Enhanced reasoning and longitudinal tracking; 4B parameter model matches 27B capabilities under distillation.
limitations: Requires structured prompts to avoid temporal hallucination.
notes: Core model version selected for fine-tuning on BRAX.

title: A Bilingual Benchmark for Evaluating Diagnostic Performance of Multimodal Large Language Models in Radiology (RadM-Bench)
authors: Qingxia Wu, Peipei Zhang, Zhifeng Yi, Yu Shen, et al.
main_results: MedGemma demonstrated superior cross-lingual consistency and clinical diagnostic accuracy on bilingual chest X-ray VQA.
limitations: Evaluated primarily in cloud GPU server environments.
notes: Supports bilingual and regional medical VLM evaluation.

title: A Survey on Multimodal Large Language Models in Radiology for Report Generation and Visual Question Answering
authors: Zhifeng Yi, Tianhua Xiao, Mark V. Albert
dataset: MIMIC-CXR, CheXpert, IU X-Ray, PadChest, BRAX
evaluation_metrics: BLEU, ROUGE-L, RadGraph F1, CheXbert F1
main_results: Comprehensive taxonomy of architectural choices, loss functions, and evaluation metrics in radiological MLLMs.
limitations: Identifies lack of standardized edge deployment benchmarks.
notes: Taxonomic baseline for model comparison.

title: A clinically accessible small multimodal radiology model and evaluation metric for chest X-ray findings (LLaVA-Rad)
authors: Jose M. Zambrano Chaves, Shih-Cheng Huang, Yuhui Xu, et al.
main_results: Demonstrates that parameter-efficient fine-tuning (LoRA) on open models yields clinically valid report generation.
limitations: 7B model size creates memory pressure on 8GB edge devices without 4-bit PTQ.
notes: Key reference for small accessible radiology models.

title: Advancing radiology foundation models with reasoning through step-by-step verification from daily reports (ChestX-Reasoner)
authors: Ziqing Fan, Cheng Liang, Chaoyi Wu, Ya Zhang, Weidi Xie, et al.
dataset: RadRBench-CXR, MIMIC-CXR, CheXpert, MS-CXR-T, RSNA, SIIM
main_results: Process supervision with reasoning chains (<think> tags) significantly reduces clinical hallucinations and improves accuracy.
limitations: Requires process reward models during RL training phase.
notes: Theoretical foundation for Reason-then-Summarize prompt engineering.

title: AnatomiX, an Anatomy-Aware Grounded Multimodal Large Language Model for Chest X-Ray Interpretation
task: Grounded Diagnosis, Phrase Grounding, Report Generation
main_results: Integrating explicit anatomical tokens and bounding box predictions enhances factual report generation accuracy.
limitations: Complex multi-token architecture increases decoding latency.
notes: Reference for anatomy-aware attention mechanisms.

title: Artificial Intelligence in Occupational Health Surveillance: Evaluating AI-Assisted ILO Classification of Radiographs of Pneumoconioses
venue: Journal of Occupational and Environmental Medicine
dataset: NIOSH B Reader Syllabus / ILO Standard Radiographs
task: ILO Classification, Small Opacity & Profusion Scoring
evaluation_metrics: Concordance with B Readers, F1-Score, Cohen's Kappa
main_results: MedGemma 4B achieved high agreement with certified B Readers in classifying parenchymal small opacities under ILO 2022 rules.
limitations: Small sample size (pilot study); zero-shot prompt sensitivity.
notes: Clinical validation of MedGemma in specialized occupational lung disease.

title: Assessing the Effectiveness of Transfer Learning in Chest X-Ray Analysis With the BRAX Dataset
authors: Elton Douglas Silva, Thiago B. Pereira, Carlos Eduardo Brandao, Francisco Boldt, Thiago M. Paixao
dataset: BRAX (Brazilian Labeled Chest X-Ray Dataset), CheXpert
training_strategy: Pre-training on CheXpert + Fine-tuning on BRAX
evaluation_metrics: ROC AUC, Precision, Recall, F1-Score (5-fold CV)
main_results: Demonstrates that domain-specific fine-tuning from CheXpert to BRAX overcomes regional domain shift and severe class imbalance.
limitations: Evaluates unimodal vision baselines without language decoder coupling.
notes: Primary reference for BRAX dataset characteristics and class imbalance.

title: Auditing Medical Vision-Language Models on Chest Radiographs: Estimating Reference Agreement Across Institutions
task: Binary Finding Elicitation & Narrative Report Audit
evaluation_metrics: Expected Calibration Error (ECE), Reference Agreement Rate
main_results: MedGemma 4B demonstrated lower calibration error (ECE 0.21) across institutions compared to larger competitors.
limitations: High variance in unmentioned/uncertain label parsing across hospital sites.
notes: Grounds cross-institutional stability and calibration metrics.

title: Automated Structured Radiology Report Generation with Rich Clinical Context (C-SRRG)
main_results: Incorporating longitudinal patient history and clinical indication reduces temporal fabrication and hallucination.
limitations: Requires multi-study historical context during inference.
notes: Reference for rich clinical context integration.

title: Automatic Radiology Report Generator Using Transformer With Contrast-Based Image Enhancement
main_results: Contrast-based image enhancement improves visual feature extraction and boosts report generation BLEU scores.
limitations: Evaluated on small Open-I dataset; lacks multimodal LLM decoder.
notes: Grounds image enhancement pre-processing strategies.

title: Avaliacao da quantizacao de modelos visuais de linguagem para implantacao em ambiente hospitalar
authors: Rafael Scalabrin Dosso, Diedre Santos do Carmo, Leticia Rittner
evaluation_metrics: F1-Score Micro (0.364 MedGemma), Peak VRAM (5.6GB), Latency
main_results: MedGemma 4B showed minimal accuracy loss under 4-bit quantization with lowest VRAM peak (5.6GB), but BitsAndBytes in Python caused a 6x latency overhead.
limitations: Identifies python/BitsAndBytes runtime overhead as critical bottleneck for real-time edge deployment.
notes: Pivotal study motivating C++ llama.cpp compilation to solve Python overhead.

title: Beyond Diagnosis: Evaluating Multimodal LLMs for Pathology Localization in Chest Radiographs
evaluation_metrics: Grid Cell Overlap Accuracy, Hit Rate (>50% IoU)
main_results: MedGemma 4B demonstrates strong spatial localization for acute findings when prompted with grid overlays.
limitations: Gridded prompting increases prompt token count.
notes: Grounds spatial reasoning and bounding box localization.

title: CMA-ES Decoding Optimization for MedGemma: A Flat Landscape on Chest X-Ray Reports
authors: Michael Chen-Wang, Miguel Abreu-Cardenas, Saul Calderon-Ramirez
main_results: Proves greedy decoding (T=0.0) achieves maximum semantic consistency (0.97) and zero stochasticity for MedGemma.
limitations: Demonstrates zero-shot bottleneck is visual perception, not sampling strategy.
notes: Justifies fixing decoding temperature strictly at zero (T=0) in the experimental protocol.

title: CheXPO: Preference Optimization for Chest X-ray VLMs with Counterfactual Rationale
main_results: Counterfactual rationale preference tuning reduces hallucination rates in chest X-ray explanations.
limitations: Requires hard negative mining pipeline.
notes: Reference for preference optimization and counterfactual rationale.

title: Chest X-Ray Report Generation Using Abnormality Guided Vision Language Model (META-CXR)
authors: Dasith Edirisinghe, Wimukthi Nimalsiri, Mahela Hennayake, Dulani Meedeniya, Gilbert Lim
main_results: Integrating expert tokens for abnormality detection directly guides the language model to generate factually accurate reports.
limitations: Requires multi-encoder ensemble increasing initial memory load.
notes: Reference for abnormality-guided soft prompting.

title: ChestGPT: Integrating Large Language Models and Vision Transformers for Disease Detection and Localization in Chest X-Rays
task: Disease Detection, Bounding Box Localization, VQA
main_results: Coupling EVA-CLIP with Llama 2 enables conversational disease detection and spatial bounding box output.
limitations: Requires large projection layers.
notes: Multimodal conversational baseline for chest X-rays.

title: ChestX-VQA: AI Tool for Multimodal Chest X-ray
main_results: Demonstrates interactive local web UI deployment for radiologist visual question answering.
limitations: Evaluated on open-ended conversational prompts.
notes: Reference for clinical interactive VQA tools.

title: CoDA: Exploring Chain-of-Distribution Attacks and Post-Hoc Token-Space Repair for Medical Vision-Language Models
authors: Xiang Chen, Fangfang Yang, Chunlei Meng, Yuxian Dong, et al.
imaging_modality: Brain MRI, Chest X-Ray, Abdominal CT
main_results: Image acquisition degradations induce high-confidence diagnostic errors in un-fine-tuned VLMs.
limitations: Focuses on adversarial perturbance rather than clean edge quantization.
notes: Supports robustness analysis under distribution shifts.

title: Comparative evaluation of generative AI models for chest radiograph report generation in the emergency department
task: Emergency Triage & Critical Finding Detection (Pneumothorax, Pneumonia)
evaluation_metrics: Sensitivity, Specificity, F1-Score for Critical Findings
main_results: Fine-tuned open models match proprietary models in emergency finding detection sensitivity.
limitations: Zero-shot baseline models exhibit lower sensitivity for subtle opacities.
notes: Clinical justification for emergency department triage focus.

title: EC-RAG: Evidence-Centric Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Medical Visual Question Answering
clinical_domain: Medical Visual Question Answering & Report Gen
main_results: Evidence-centric retrieval grounds VLM outputs in verified clinical triplets before text generation.
limitations: Requires offline triplet indexing.
notes: Reference for evidence-centric RAG architectures.

title: Edge-Deployed Lightweight LLMs for Medical Imaging: Real-Time Dual Report Generation with Progression Aware Summarization
authors: Vikas Hassija, Sparsh Bajoria, Adhitya M.
clinical_domain: Edge Medical Imaging & Longitudinal Report Gen
task: Real-time Dual Report Generation & Progression Summarization
hardware: NVIDIA Jetson Orin / Mobile GPU / Raspberry Pi 4
evaluation_metrics: Model Size (620MB), Tokens/sec Latency, F1-Score, MAE/MSE Progression
main_results: Proves that compressing medical LLMs to < 1GB via distillation, pruning, and quantization enables real-time 15W edge deployment with stable F1 performance.
limitations: Requires initial teacher distillation step.
notes: CORE SYSTEM REFERENCE (N_f2 #1): Hardware telemetria and compression for edge deployability.

title: Efficient and Trustworthy AI for Pneumonia Detection on Edge Devices
hardware: NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano / Raspberry Pi 5
main_results: Quantized edge models maintain high pneumonia sensitivity under strict power budgets (< 15W).
limitations: Evaluated primarily on binary classification without full free-text laudo generation.
notes: Supports edge pneumonia triage feasibility.

title: Evaluating Prompting Strategies with MedGemma for Medical Order Extraction
authors: Abhinand Balachandran, Bavana Durgapraveen Gowsikkan Sikkan Sudhagar, Vidhya Varshany J.S., Sriram Rajkumar
training_strategy: One-Shot Prompting vs. ReAct vs. Multi-Agent Flow
evaluation_metrics: ROUGE-1 F1, Strict Order Type F1, Provenance F1
main_results: Proves simple One-Shot prompting outperforms complex ReAct/Agentic loops on MedGemma by eliminating overthinking and noise.
limitations: Evaluated on text dialogue transcripts.
notes: Justifies concise one-shot JSON formatting templates.

title: Evaluation of Machine Learning Methods Developed for Prediction and Diagnosis of Pneumonia: A Systematic Review
dataset: MIMIC-CXR, CheXpert, RSNA, Local Hospital Datasets
model: CNNs, ViTs, VLMs, Random Forest, SVM
main_results: Synthesizes diagnostic benchmarks for pneumonia, highlighting class imbalance as the main barrier to clinical generalization.
limitations: Most reviewed studies relied on unquantized server models.
notes: Provides methodological baseline for pneumonia systematic review protocol.

title: EviRAG: Evidence-Guided Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Medical Vision-Language Models
main_results: Structured evidence triplets (finding, presence, laterality) prevent conflicting report generation.
limitations: Requires offline database triplet indexing.
notes: Reference for evidence-guided RAG and laterality verification.

title: Fine-Tuning MedGemma for Clinical Captioning to Enhance Multimodal RAG over Malaysia CPGs
training_strategy: SFT via QLoRA with Synthetic Teacher Filtering
main_results: Fine-tuning MedGemma with QLoRA generates uncertainty-aware, high-fidelity clinical descriptions suitable for downstream RAG.
limitations: Filtered synthetic corpus required teacher model distillation.
notes: Demonstrates QLoRA fine-tuning recipe for MedGemma 4B.

title: Forensic Implications of Localized AI: Artifact Analysis of Ollama, LM Studio, and llama.cpp
task: Offline Model Serving, Memory Profiling & Artifact Recovery
evaluation_metrics: Execution Memory Footprint, Log Persistence, File Signature Recovery
main_results: Detailed forensic and execution characterization of llama.cpp and GGUF format, proving zero external network leaks during local offline inference.
limitations: Focuses on forensic audit rather than medical diagnostic accuracy.
notes: Sustains local security, offline data privacy, and llama.cpp runtime behavior.

title: From Technical Prerequisites to Improved Care: Distributed Edge AI for Tomographic Imaging
hardware: NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin / Jetson Orin Nano
evaluation_metrics: Network Latency, Triage Speed, Privacy Compliance
main_results: Edge-deployed distributed AI eliminates cloud data transmission delays and ensures local hospital data sovereignty.
limitations: Requires localized edge hardware infrastructure.
notes: Supports edge infrastructure prerequisites in medical imaging.

title: Google-MedGemma Based Abnormality Detection in Musculoskeletal radiographs
main_results: MedGemma 4B outperforms generalist multimodal models (GPT-4) in detecting subtle radiographic bone abnormalities.
limitations: Evaluated on extremity radiographs rather than chest X-rays.
notes: Demonstrates MedGemma's visual encoder strength on radiographic data.

title: HERO: Hierarchical Evidential Reasoning Optimization for Radiology Report Generation via Reason-then-Summarize
main_results: Enforcing a <think> block for free-text reasoning prior to an <answer> JSON output yields near 100% self-consistency and eliminates hallucinations.
limitations: Requires structured reward modeling during RL.
notes: Pivotal reference for the Reason-then-Summarize prompt structure.

title: Harrison.Rad 1.5 Technical Report: A radiology foundation model that can draft reports from images, priors and clinical context
task: Drafting Reports from Images, Priors, and Context
training_strategy: Instruction Tuning + Contrastive Hard Negative Alignment
evaluation_metrics: RadGraph F1, RadCliQ-v1, CheXBERT, Judge F-D Score
main_results: Presents commercial benchmark comparisons where open small models (MedGemma 4B) are evaluated against massive closed models.
limitations: Proprietary model and closed training data.
notes: Industry benchmark comparison reference.

title: Investigating Robustness in Vision-Language Models via Adversarial Prompt Illumination
main_results: Biomedical vision encoders exhibit significantly higher resilience to prompt perturbations compared to general CLIP encoders.
limitations: Focuses on retrieval rather than generative report decoders.
notes: Grounds the choice of specialized medical vision encoders (MedSigLIP).

title: Knowledge-Driven Vision-Language Model for Plexus Detection in Hirschsprung's Disease
main_results: Knowledge-driven prompt constraints improve small target detection in medical imaging.
limitations: Domain-specific histopathology scope.
notes: Domain-specific medical VLM reference.

title: MGK-RAG: Multi-Granularity Knowledge Guided Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Radiology Report
main_results: Multi-granularity knowledge retrieval balances global image semantics with fine-grained local lesion descriptions.
limitations: Requires top-k document retrieval pipeline.
notes: Supports multi-granularity RAG design.

title: MIRA: A Novel Framework for Fusing Modalities in Medical RAG
main_results: Joint embedding fusion prevents modality mismatch in medical retrieval-augmented generation.
limitations: Requires dual vector databases for text and vision.
notes: Multimodal fusion architecture reference.

title: AWQ: Activation-aware Weight Quantization for On-Device LLM Compression and Acceleration
authors: Ji Lin, Jiaming Tang, Haotian Tang, Shang Yang, Xingyu Dang, Song Han
venue: MLSys 2024 (Conference on Machine Learning and Systems)
hardware: NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano (8GB, 15W) / Mobile GPUs
evaluation_metrics: Memory Footprint Reduction (4x), Latency Acceleration (3x-6x), Perplexity Loss (< 0.1)
main_results: Proves that protecting 0.1% salient channels identified via activation magnitudes preserves model reasoning under 4-bit quantization, enabling fast CUDA/ARM NEON register dequantization.
limitations: Requires activation profiling pass on calibration dataset.
notes: CORE SYSTEM REFERENCE (N_f2 #2): Mathematical foundation for AWQ post-training quantization and llama.cpp runtime.

title: MedGemma vs GPT-4: Open-Source and Proprietary Zero-shot Medical Disease Classification from Images
authors: Md. Sazzadul Islam Prottasha, Nabil Walid Rafi
venue: Journal of Machine Learning and Deep Learning (JMLDL)
imaging_modality: Chest Radiograph, Dermoscopy, OCT, Mammography, ECG
dataset: CheXpert, HAM10000, OCT-Chest, Breast Cancer Dataset
evaluation_metrics: Mean Accuracy (80.37% MedGemma vs 69.58% GPT-4), Macro F1
main_results: MedGemma 4B significantly outperforms GPT-4 in zero-shot medical image classification due to its domain-specific MedSigLIP vision encoder.
limitations: Zero-shot performance is lower than SFT fine-tuned variants.
notes: Grounds the superiority of MedGemma's medical vision encoder over general GPT-4.

title: MediVLM: A Vision Language Model for Radiology Report Generation from Medical Images
evaluation_metrics: BLEU-4 (0.476 IU, 0.170 MIMIC), RadGraph F1, RaTEScore
main_results: Integrating patch feature extraction with BioT5 autoregressive decoding improves narrative fluency and clinical accuracy.
limitations: Uses older Faster R-CNN object detector.
notes: Reference for severity score computation.

title: Pneumonia Detection from Chest X-Ray Images Using Deep Learning and Transfer Learning for Imbalanced Datasets
main_results: Identifies that BRAX contains only 148 defect-free positive pneumonia images, demonstrating extreme class imbalance in Brazilian data.
limitations: Evaluated on unimodal classifiers without text laudo decoders.
notes: Grounds the exact pneumonia sample count (148 cases) in BRAX.

title: RadVLM: A Multitask Conversational Vision-Language Model for Radiology
task: Free-text Report Generation, VQA, Phrase Grounding
main_results: Unified conversational framework handles report generation and bounding box localization seamlessly.
limitations: Full model requires quantization for 8GB RAM devices.
notes: Multitask conversational baseline reference.

title: ReXVQA: A Large-scale Visual Question Answering Benchmark for Generalist Chest X-ray Understanding
task: Differential Diagnosis, Location Assessment, Negation Assessment
evaluation_metrics: Overall Accuracy (83.84% MedGemma vs 77.27% Resident), Failed Extractions
main_results: MedGemma 4B significantly outperformed senior human radiology residents in overall diagnostic accuracy (83.84% vs 77.27%).
limitations: Evaluated under multiple-choice and structured VQA formats.
notes: Key benchmark proving MedGemma's superiority over human resident baseline.

title: Scalable Training of SpatiaGrounded 2D Vision-Language Models for Radiology
task: Spatial Detection, Segmentation, Bounding Box Grounding
main_results: Unfreezing spatial projection layers allows 4B models to achieve 87.7% detection F1 on radiological bounding boxes.
limitations: Requires pixel-coordinate annotations during SFT.
notes: Spatial grounding training strategy reference.

title: Segmentation-Guided Radiology Report Generation for Pneumothorax Detection in Chest X-Rays
training_strategy: SFT via QLoRA with Dual Image-Mask Fusion
main_results: Fusing binary segmentation masks into the VLM prompt increases report generation fidelity and prevents missed pneumothorax diagnoses.
limitations: Requires a prior segmentation model to generate masks at inference time.
notes: Reference for mask-guided report generation.

title: Taming Vision-Language Models for Federated Foundation Models on Heterogeneous Medical Imaging Modalities
evaluation_metrics: Cross-Site AUC, Privacy Retention, Parameter Traffic (MB)
main_results: Federated prompt tuning allows hospitals to collaboratively train medical VLMs without sharing raw patient images.
limitations: Requires synchronized communications between hospital clients.
notes: Grounds privacy-preserving distributed deployment.

title: Taming Vision-Language Models for Medical Image Analysis: A Comprehensive Review
task: Survey of Pre-training, Fine-tuning, and Quantization
training_strategy: Survey of SFT, DPO, RLHF, PTQ
main_results: Comprehensive review highlighting parameter-efficient fine-tuning (QLoRA) and GGUF quantization as key drivers for medical AI democratization.
limitations: Qualitative literature synthesis.
notes: Comprehensive survey reference.

title: Utilizing Longitudinal Chest X-Rays and Reports to Pre-Fill Radiology Reports
authors: Qingqing Zhu, Tejas Sudharshan Mathai, Pritam Mukherjee, Yifan Peng, Ronald M. Summers, Zhiyong Lu
task: Pre-Filling Findings Section from Prior Reports & Images
main_results: Prior reports contain high direct transfer text, improving pre-filled current findings quality by over 20%.
limitations: Evaluated on custom non-LLM transformer decoder.
notes: Reference for longitudinal report pre-filling and prior report transfer.

title: Vision Language Models in Medicine
main_results: Comprehensive analysis of 25M multimodal medical datasets and prompt strategies for clinical instruction tuning.
limitations: Broad survey overview.
notes: Reference for multi-granularity medical dataset pipelines.

title: Vision-Language Models in Medical Applications: A Review
task: Review of Diagnostic VQA, Report Generation, and Edge Deployment
evaluation_metrics: RadGraph F1, CheXbert F1, Latency, VRAM Footprint
main_results: Systematic review confirming that 4-bit GGUF quantization combined with C++ engines (llama.cpp) is the leading paradigm for privacy-compliant hospital edge AI.
limitations: Identifies lack of standardized edge hardware benchmark protocols.
notes: State-of-the-art review reference.

title: XMedFusion: A Knowledge-Guided Multimodal Perception and Reasoning Framework for Autonomous Medical Systems
main_results: Integrating structured medical knowledge graphs during feature fusion prevents factual errors in automated report generation.
limitations: Requires ontology mapping for local diseases.
notes: Knowledge graph integration reference.

title: Zero-Shot Performance of Six Vision-Language Models for Lung Nodule Detection on Chest Radiographs
dataset_size: 1,200 chest X-rays with verified lung nodules
model: MedGemma 4B, CheXagent 8B, LLaVA-Med, Qwen-VL, GPT-4o, Claude Opus
main_results: MedGemma 4B demonstrates highest zero-shot sensitivity for dense pulmonary nodules among open 4B models.
limitations: Zero-shot performance without SFT leaves room for false positives on minor scars.
notes: Grounds zero-shot lung nodule classification benchmarks.

title: LLaMA32-Med: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning of Lightweight Medical Vision-Language Models
main_results: Two-stage LoRA fine-tuning aligns lightweight language decoders with medical vision features efficiently.
limitations: Evaluated on small conversational VQA samples.
notes: Reference for two-stage parameter-efficient alignment.

title: Ajuste Fino Supervisionado (SFT) do MedGemma 1.5 4B com Dados Brasileiros (BRAX)
authors: Equipe de Pesquisa (Artigo Nvidia / ajuste fino.pdf)
clinical_domain: Radiologia Hospitalar Nacional & Triagem de Pneumonia
task: Triagem Diagnostica de Pneumonia & Geração de Laudo Estruturado
hardware: Host: NVIDIA RTX 4090 (24GB VRAM, BF16, AdamW 8-bit)
evaluation_metrics: F1-Score Pneumonia (Micro/Macro), Validation Loss, Cross-Entropy Loss
main_results: Ajuste-fino supervisionado via QLoRA no host RTX 4090 especializou o MedGemma 4B para pneumonia em dados brasileiros com convergência estavel em 3 épocas.
limitations: Exige separação rigorosa por paciente para evitar vazamento de dados.
notes: Documentação primária do procedimento SFT em GPU Host do projeto.

title: Delineamento Experimental e Protocolo de Testes do Sistema de Triagem no Jetson Orin Nano
clinical_domain: Triagem Clinica de Emergencia & UPA Off-grid
dataset_size: Conjunto de Teste Pareado (Paired Test Data)
task: Inferencia Local Offline de Pneumonia & Telemetria Fisica
hardware: NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano Developer Kit (8GB RAM, 15W)
evaluation_metrics: F1-Score, Latencia de Inferencia (s), Pico de VRAM (GB), Consumo de Energia (W)
main_results: Estabelece o protocolo de validacao do sistema embarcado no Jetson Orin Nano sob limite de 15W com votação por maioria simples e temperatura zero.
limitations: Restrito a 8GB de memória RAM unificada na placa de borda.
notes: Protocolo experimental de validacao de hardware e telemetria do sistema.
